nodes.description: Contract owner address, initialized from msg.sender at deployment and used by only_owner modifiers.
Monotonic counter of created games, incremented in createGame.
Constant 4 week lock period applied to losing bets before refunds.
Boolean flag gating token purchases in the payable fallback function.
Mapping gameId => Game struct holding status, per-option totals and timing.
Mapping gameId => Result struct with winning option, locktime and payout totals.
Mapping gameId => Option[] storing each bettor's stake per option.
ERC20-style balance ledger used for betting funds and token issuance.
ERC20-style allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.
Cumulative ether contributed through the fallback crowd-sale.
Hard cap of total contribution enforced by etherCapNotReached.
Total token supply, minted on purchase and adjusted on winner redemption.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances, allowances and bet attribution.
Block time (now) used for bet deadlines, lock times and refund eligibility.
ERC20 transfer; checks msg.data length, value and an overflow condition before moving balances.
ERC20 transferFrom with inverted sufficiency/allowance/overflow comparisons, permitting unauthorized transfers.
ERC20 approve that blocks non-zero overwrite of an existing allowance.
Owner-only game creation that increments gamesIndex and pushes Option slots.
Places a bet by debiting balances and accumulating totals without safe math.
Claims winnings or refunds after a game is Done; uses now against locktime.
Computes proportional payout using safeMul/safeDiv over bet totals.
Owner-only settlement that sets Result with locktime now + LOSER_LOCK_TIME.
Owner-only ether withdrawal using the low-level send primitive.
Constant view returning total and per-option bet volumes.
Returns the caller's recorded bet for a game option.
Owner-only sweep of an arbitrary external ERC20 token held by the contract.
Owner-only toggle enabling purchases.
Owner-only toggle disabling purchases.
Payable crowd-sale entry point that forwards ether to owner and mints tokens.
Betting window check comparing now against finishTime and lazily ending stale games.
Checked multiplication helper asserting no overflow.
Checked addition helper asserting no overflow.
Checked division helper asserting non-zero divisor.
Inverted comparisons (fromBalance <= _value, allowance <= _value, overflow test >) allow transfers with insufficient funds/allowance and misdetect overflow.
owner.send(bal) external call in drain, a value transfer to a possibly reentrant recipient.
External call to an attacker-supplied token contract via token.transfer, enabling callback reentrancy.
owner.transfer(msg.value) executed inside the payable fallback before contribution accounting completes.
curr.totalBets[option] += _value and curr.total += _value performed without safeAdd, enabling arithmetic overflow.
_value parameter of transfer.
_from parameter of transferFrom.
_to parameter of transferFrom.
game parameter of redeem/predictWinner.
option parameter of redeem.
bal parameter of drain, the ether amount sent to owner.
fromBalance local caching balances[msg.sender] in transfer.
overflowed local in transferFrom whose comparison is inverted.
val local holding the losing stake refunded in redeem.

edges.reason: owner is initialized from msg.sender at deployment, so ownership derives from caller input.
msg.sender indexes balances in transfer.
msg.sender indexes the allowance lookup in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes allowed and emits Approval in approve.
msg.sender funds and is credited with the bet in predictWinner.
msg.sender claim and payout target in redeem.
only_owner compares msg.sender to owner to gate the drain.
fallback credits balances[msg.sender] with issued tokens.
now is compared to finishTime to decide whether betting is open.
locktime is computed as now + LOSER_LOCK_TIME in finishGame.
refund eligibility depends on results[game].locktime < now in redeem.
transfer reads and writes balances.
transferFrom reads and writes balances.
predictWinner debits balances[msg.sender].
redeem credits balances[msg.sender] with the refund or prize.
fallback mints into balances[msg.sender].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
predictWinner reads and mutates games[game] totals and status.
redeem reads game status through the canRedeem modifier.
finishGame updates games[game].status and reads totals.
canBet reads games[gameId] status and finishTime.
getTotalPrediction reads games[game] totals.
getPrediction reads game state for the caller.
predictWinner records the stake in gameOptions.
redeem reads and zeroes gameOptions stakes.
getPrediction returns gameOptions status for msg.sender.
redeem compares results[game].winningOption and locktime.
calculatePrize reads results[game] payout denominators.
finishGame writes results[game].
redeem adjusts totalSupply when paying winners.
fallback increases totalSupply with issued tokens.
fallback accumulates totalContribution.
cap bounds the contribution asserted by etherCapNotReached.
fallback requires purchasingAllowed before minting.
enablePurchasing sets purchasingAllowed to true.
disablePurchasing sets purchasingAllowed to false.
only_owner gate on drain uses owner.
only_owner gate on withdrawForeignTokens uses owner.
only_owner gate on createGame uses owner.
only_owner gate on finishGame uses owner.
only_owner gate on enablePurchasing uses owner.
only_owner gate on disablePurchasing uses owner.
LOSER_LOCK_TIME offsets the settlement locktime.
createGame increments gamesIndex to allocate the new game id.
transferFrom's conditionals feed the inverted sufficiency, allowance and overflow checks.
drain performs the low-level owner.send value transfer.
withdrawForeignTokens calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
fallback pushes ether to owner via transfer during accounting.
predictWinner accumulates totals without safeAdd.
the inverted overflowed local is consumed by the unsafe comparison set.
_value parameter drives the balance movement in transfer.
_from parameter selects the debited balance in transferFrom.
_to parameter selects the credited balance in transferFrom.
game parameter selects which game is redeemed.
option parameter selects the bet being redeemed.
bal parameter is the amount passed to owner.send in drain.
fromBalance local caches the caller balance in transfer.
val local holds the losing stake credited back in redeem.
send executes the recipient's fallback, allowing reentry into drain.
a malicious foreign token contract can reenter withdrawForeignTokens.
owner.transfer invokes the owner fallback mid-execution of the crowd-sale fallback.
redeem invokes calculatePrize on the winning branch.
calculatePrize multiplies via safeMul.
calculatePrize divides via safeDiv.
the etherCapNotReached modifier checks the cap using safeAdd.
predictWinner requires canBet to return true before accepting a bet.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _value is only meaningful as the amount moved by the transfer function.
Parameter _from identifies the debited account inside transferFrom.
Parameter _to identifies the credited account inside transferFrom.
Parameter game selects the game state consumed by redeem.
Parameter option selects the stake consumed by redeem.
Parameter bal flows directly into owner.send inside drain.
Local fromBalance is a cached read of balances used only in transfer.
Local overflowed is the inverted overflow predicate consumed by the unsafe check set.
Local val is the refund amount produced and credited inside redeem.
